```plato

    // The slot of the ring through `head` that the vertex at `holeSlot` bridges to,
    // or -1 when the ray escapes the ring — only possible when the declared
    // containment invariant is broken.
    BridgeSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>,
        head: Integer, holeSlot: Integer): Integer
    {
        var hole = points.NodePoint(nodes, holeSlot);
        var seed = -1;
        var rayX = Number.MinValue;
        var slot = head;
        var stepped = false;
        while (stepped.Not || slot != head)
        {
            stepped = true;
            var next = nodes.At(slot).Next;
            var x = points.LeftwardHit(nodes, slot, hole);
            if (x > rayX)
            {
                rayX = x;
                seed = points.NodePoint(nodes, slot).X < points.NodePoint(nodes, next).X
                    ? slot : next;
            }
            slot = next;
        }
        return seed < 0 ? -1 : points.VisibleSlot(nodes, head, seed, holeSlot, rayX);
    }
```
